backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining types (Session, ContextSwitch, BreakSession, Achievement, FocusScore, FocusSessionViolation, etc.) and public functions to record sessions, switches, breaks, achievements, focus violations, and scores, storing data in Maps keyed by Principal.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades actor state from OldActor (with only focusScores) to NewActor (adding focusSessionViolations map), preserving existing focus scores and initializing empty violations map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including focus session setup with duration selection, tab switch tracking between productive/distractive sections, three-strike grayscale warning system, violation counter reset, and distractive content locking during focus sessions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including main App component with routing, Layout with navigation, Dashboard with metrics, LiveMonitor with real-time tracking, various break/achievement/report pages, and reusable UI components for metrics, charts, warnings, and overlays.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, borders, charts, and sidebar components using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx, setting viewport and page title to 'Productivity & Focus Monitoring Application'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup, theme provider, protected routes for dashboard/monitor/apps/breaks/achievements/reports/focus-session, burnout monitoring with warnings/grayscale overlay/blocking, and focus session violation tracking with distractive content wrappers.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsBadg: Achievement badge card component displaying title, description, image, unlock status with date badge, and progress bar for locked achievements with grayscale effect on locked badges.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsGall: Achievements gallery displaying all badges in a grid with unlock progress counter, export all button, and share button on each unlocked achievement that copies to clipboard with toast notification.
frontend/src/components/BlockScreen.tsx: Full-screen blocking interface that displays during a 25-minute focus session with a countdown timer, progress bar, and rotating productivity tips. Timer only advances when user maintains focus with low tab switching.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutWarning.t: Dismissible warning card that appears in bottom-right corner when burnout index reaches 30+, suggesting a desk recovery break. Reappears if burnout increases by 10+ points after dismissal.
frontend/src/components/DailyRecommendat: Card component that displays a numbered list of personalized daily productivity tips to improve user focus.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Non-intrusive notification in bottom-right corner that appears when user switches tabs frequently (e.g., 10+ times in 2 minutes), encouraging focused work. Dismissible with smooth animations.
frontend/src/components/DistractiveConte: Full-screen lock card that blocks access to distractive content during focus sessions when violation limit is exceeded. Shows countdown timer and progress bar until session completes.
Wrapper component that applies grayscale filter to distractive content when violation limits are exceeded during focus sessions. Displays a warning overlay with remaining time.
frontend/src/components/FocusSessionSumm: Post-session summary card displaying duration, violation count, warning cycles, and focus score with performance feedback. Shows metrics in a grid layout with progress bar.
frontend/src/components/GreyscaleOverlay: Full-screen overlay that applies progressive grayscale filter (0-100%) based on burnout level, activating at burnout index 60+ with smooth transitions. Does not block pointer events.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with sticky header, navigation sidebar, user profile dropdown with Internet Identity integration, and quick action buttons for desk recovery and walk breaks.
frontend/src/components/MetricsCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying metric values with title, icon, and optional trend indicator showing percentage change from previous week.
frontend/src/components/PatternCard.tsx: Displays a card showing a productivity pattern with title, description, trend text, and an icon (TrendingUp/TrendingDown) styled based on whether the pattern is positive or negative.
frontend/src/components/PeriodicReport.t: Renders a periodic report view with time period selection (week/month), export functionality, and displays positive patterns and areas for improvement using PatternCard components.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityScor: Displays an overall productivity score (0-100) with a circular progress indicator, color-coded rating label, descriptive feedback text, and a progress bar.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: A route guard component that checks Internet Identity authentication status and redirects unauthenticated users to the login page, showing a loading spinner during initialization.
frontend/src/components/RecoveryQualityC: Displays a pie chart showing the breakdown of restorative vs. non-restorative break time using Recharts, with data from the useBreakAnalytics hook.
frontend/src/components/ValidationMetric: Shows detailed validation metrics for context switching including total switches, frequency rates, distraction score breakdown with formula, and a table of recent switching events with timestamps and durations.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Manages a static list of achievements with unlock status, progress tracking, and provides a function to share achievement text to clipboard.
Simulates user activity by randomly switching between applications, persists state to localStorage, tracks switch counts and frequencies, and records switches to the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance using React Query, handling both authenticated and anonymous modes based on Internet Identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useApplications.ts: Manages a list of applications categorized as productive or distracting, with CRUD operations persisted to localStorage and initialized with default apps like VS Code, Slack, Facebook, and YouTube.
frontend/src/hooks/useBlockingLogic.ts: Implements progressive blocking system that activates after 2 warning dismissals, requiring a 25-minute productive session with low switching frequency to unlock, with timer only decrementing during focused work.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakAnalytics.ts: Provides mock break analytics data showing restorative vs non-restorative break time percentages (currently hardcoded to 45 and 15 minutes).
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakTimer.ts: Manages break timers for desk recovery and walk breaks, recording break sessions to the backend actor with start/end timestamps, duration, and restorative status.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreathingAnimation: Controls breathing exercise animation phases (inhale, hold, exhale, rest) with corresponding scale values, cycling through a 16-second breathing pattern when active.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutMonitor.ts: Calculates burnout index (0-100) based on switching frequency and distraction score, categorizing into three levels and managing warning dismissals with localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts: Aggregates focus scores and reports from backend queries to calculate dashboard metrics including focus time, distraction time, switching frequency, productivity score, burnout trends, and personalized recommendations with fallback to mock data.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts: Tracks browser tab switching and window focus events using Page Visibility API and focus/blur listeners to calculate distraction metrics (switch count, switches per minute/hour, time away) and sends data to backend every 10 seconds, with state restoration from backend on mount.
Manages focus session timer with start/pause/resume/reset controls, countdown logic, completion detection, and localStorage persistence for maintaining state across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusSessionViolat: Tracks violations during focus sessions when users navigate from productive to distractive routes, enforcing grayscale mode and locking after threshold violations. Persists violation state to localStorage and records tab switches to backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Provides a simple timer that counts up in seconds while active and formats the duration as MM:SS.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and identity persistence with AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching reports, focus scores, activity data, and focus sessions from the backend actor, plus a mutation hook for recording focus scores.
frontend/src/hooks/useReportData.ts: Returns mock positive and negative productivity patterns with loading state based on selected time period (week/month).
frontend/src/hooks/useWalkBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for walk breaks with start/pause/reset controls, plays alert sound on completion, and records break data to backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, supportive color palette for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/copyConstants.ts: Centralized copy text constants for app name, warnings, blocking messages, and break benefits/tips.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that wraps App with InternetIdentityProvider and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Page component displaying the AchievementsGallery with header and description.
frontend/src/pages/AppCategorization.tsx: Page for managing application categories (productive/distracting), allowing users to add, edit, and delete applications with inline editing and category selection.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard displaying productivity metrics, focus time, distraction warnings, burnout trends, recommendations, and charts with real-time focus monitoring and cooldown-based warning system.
frontend/src/pages/DeskRecovery.tsx: Guided breathing exercise page with animated breathing circle, timer controls, and instructions for a 5-minute desk recovery session.
frontend/src/pages/FocusSession.tsx: Focus session timer with preset and custom durations, violation tracking, grayscale mode, progress display, and session summary with backend recording via ICP actor.
frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx: Real-time activity monitoring page showing current application, focus duration, tab switching metrics, and validation metrics with backend data integration and fallback mock data.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Login page component that uses Internet Identity authentication, displays app features (track focus, prevent burnout, build habits), and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Reports page component that displays behavioral reports and productivity patterns using the PeriodicReport component.
frontend/src/pages/WalkBreak.tsx: Walk break timer page with configurable duration (5-60 minutes), play/pause/reset controls, progress visualization, and quick preset buttons for common break lengths.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for Application, ContextSwitch, FocusSession, FocusSessionViolation, and FocusSessionState interfaces used throughout the app.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended theme (border radius, shadows, animations), typography and container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document defining a web-based focus monitoring system with tab switch tracking, three-strike warning system with grayscale effects, session-based locking, and productive/distractive content categorization.
